users.description: Authenticated users for the MVP and future multi-user expansion.

auth_sessions.description: Hashed, expiring server-side login sessions that can be revoked on logout.

boards.description: One active board per user for the MVP.

board_columns.description: Fixed Kanban columns for each board, with editable titles and order.

cards.description: Individual Kanban cards. Each card belongs to one board and one column; ordering is tracked by position.

chat_messages.description: Optional future conversation history for the AI sidebar; not required for MVP but included for extension.

relationships.users_to_boards: one user can have many boards (future-ready, but MVP uses one board per user)
relationships.board_columns_to_cards: one column can contain many cards
relationships.cards_to_board: each card belongs to the board it is displayed on

notes: Rows are intentionally simple because the MVP only requires a single board and single-user login flow.
The schema is designed so future multi-user support, multiple boards, and AI chat history can be added without reworking the core model.
Column and card ordering is stored as integer positions to keep drag-and-drop operations deterministic.
